notes: All Wikidata QIDs are training-knowledge hints only — unverified at write time. QC must verify each QID before promotion.
Nodes with ambiguous:true are structurally present but require human judgment on scope, granularity, or academic_status before promotion.

The field:philosophy node is domain:humanities per standard classification; however philosophy of logic and formal logic have strong formal_sciences ties — QC should consider whether logic should carry a cross-domain note.

Three original emerging subfields (philosophy-of-psychiatry, philosophy-of-information, experimental-philosophy) are included at 'emerging' status because they have dedicated journals and associations but limited standalone course offerings at most departments.
Natural philosophy and scholasticism are tagged 'historical' — they no longer exist as live research programs, but are present because UDC class 1 and LCC B–BJ retain classification entries for them.

Esotericism-and-theosophy is tagged 'non_academic' — it appears in library classifications (UDC 135, LCC BF1999+) and is studied academically (Aries journal, Wouter Hanegraaff's work at Amsterdam), but the traditions themselves make no academic claims.
